purpose: Verify faculty can view their own project portfolio and details
preconditions: Faculty member has submitted research proposals and consultancy projects
action_or_input: Invoke get_user_proposals and check contract representation
expected_result: Returns project summary contracts for the authenticated user

purpose: Verify structured audit trail records all review decisions and actions
preconditions: Action performed on proposal or request
action_or_input: Instantiate RSPCAuditTrail record with actor_id, entity_type, action, timestamp
expected_result: Audit trail record stores mandatory fields and orders by timestamp descending

purpose: Verify departmental HoD review and recommendation permissions and status
action_or_input: Check HoD role grants and proposal recommended status constant
expected_result: HoD has recommend permission and RECOMMENDED_HOD status is valid

purpose: Verify Dean-RSPC approval authority within delegated powers
preconditions: Request amount is below Dean delegation limit
action_or_input: Evaluate DEAN_FINANCIAL_DELEGATION_LIMIT and Dean permissions
expected_result: Dean has approval permission and delegation threshold is 200,000

purpose: Verify Director authorization is required for large funding proposals >= 10 Lakhs
action_or_input: Call is_director_approval_required('proposal', 1500000)
expected_result: Returns True indicating Director escalation required

purpose: Verify research proposal core data capture including mandatory fields
action_or_input: Pass valid dictionary to validate_research_proposal
expected_result: Empty error list indicating valid submission

purpose: Verify proposal validation rejects submissions with missing mandatory fields or invalid duration
preconditions: Invalid payload with missing fields, negative budget, and timeline_months=0
action_or_input: Call validate_research_proposal with invalid dictionary
expected_result: Validation errors must flag missing title, budget, end date, and non-positive timeline

purpose: Verify proposal routing status sequence across workflow stages
action_or_input: Inspect PROPOSAL_STATUS_CHOICES sequence constants
expected_result: Draft, Submitted, Recommended, Verified, Approved statuses are present

purpose: Verify decision record captures actor, action, and remarks
action_or_input: Create RSPCAuditTrail with remarks and decision details
expected_result: Audit trail accurately preserves decision metadata

purpose: Verify consultancy registration core data capture
action_or_input: Validate consultancy project payload with valid data
expected_result: validate_consultancy_project returns no errors

purpose: Verify consultancy financial terms validation enforces institutional share >= 20%
action_or_input: Call validate_consultancy_project with missing required institutional share
expected_result: Errors list must enforce institutional share >= 20% policy

purpose: Verify consultancy approval routing escalates high-value consultancy (>= 10L) to Director
action_or_input: Call is_director_approval_required('consultancy', 1500000.00)
expected_result: Returns True requiring Director approval for large consultancy

purpose: Verify consultancy tracking model captures deliverables and status

preconditions: Available budget is 50,000; requested amount is 80,000

purpose: Verify financial approval escalation to Director for high-value requests >= 2 Lakhs
action_or_input: Call is_director_approval_required('financial', 250000)
expected_result: Returns True indicating Director escalation required

purpose: Verify procurement request creation and model structure
